entity.summary: Italian centralized cryptocurrency exchange ecosystem offering a beginner-oriented exchange and the advanced Young Platform Pro order-book venue through a shared account and euro wallet.
entity.notes: HEI consolidates Young Platform and Young Platform Pro as one exchange entity because first-party documentation states that both use the same account, authentication, euro wallet, and shared balances. Current first-party support pages identify Young Platform S.p.A. in Turin, Italy. Independent sources disagree on whether the company was founded in 2018 or the exchange was established in 2019, so no launch date is asserted.

evidence.title: Difference between Young Platform and Young Platform Pro
evidence.notes: First-party support documentation identifies the beginner and Pro exchange surfaces and states that they share one account, authentication system, euro wallet, and balances, supporting consolidation as one entity.

evidence.title: Young Platform exchange profile and current markets
evidence.notes: Current independent profile identifies an Italy-registered centralized exchange and reports recently updated EUR, BTC, and USDC markets with non-zero activity.
